title: Mitchell13's Vanilla+
description: My own swing at creating a custom vanilla experience
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8924e8ec4da99e4789a72efff84b4eea06869360.png)

This is my swing at making a pack focussed on performance, visuals & technicality!
I'll try to update the pack regularly everytime there will be a change in mod availability.

## Featured mods!
_The mods that I regularly use and can not go without!_
- [Better F3](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterf3)
- [Minihud](https://modrinth.com/mod/minihud)
- [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica)
- [Inventory Profiles Next](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-profiles-next)
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)
## Shaders!
Of course [Iris shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) is in the pack together with [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches), for those sweet visuals!
## Resource Packs!
Animation based recourse packs like [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) are also included!
